frequency_question: What proportion of major centrally sponsored financial incentive or subsidy schemes proposed by a line ministry are successfully notified and operationalized within a roughly one-year window from formal announcement?
membership_rule: Includes central sector schemes involving financial subsidies, credit guarantees, or capital outlays managed by industrial/infrastructure line ministries (e.g., Heavy Industries, Road Transport, Power) announced for formal notification. Excludes minor amendments or routine budgetary allocations without standalone structural frameworks.

cases.name: FAME-II Scheme (Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles)
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Auto and Auto Components
PM Electric Drive Revolution in Intelligent Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 major targeted EV and industrial subsidy frameworks introduced by the Ministry of Heavy Industries and related line ministries over the past decade; all successfully cleared and notified.
known_gaps: May omit minor sub-schemes or internal pilot programs that were abandoned pre-notification, though high-profile transport/manufacturing financing schemes tracked in this class have a 100% completion rate once formally tabled.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 identified major analogous schemes
validity_reason: Bureaucratic clearance norms and administrative procedures for central line ministries under established rules of business remain stable across medium-term electoral cycles.
